title: A civic leader in Harlem
summary: Johnson says he helped many people outside the music.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: Huh. It's wonderful. It's really wonderful. Now, if this -- I have a feeling this -- in one of the reference books I saw J. C. Johnson described as a civic leader in Harlem. Would you say that's accurate?
Well, what do you mean by civic leader?
Well, that's all they said, a civic leader in Harlem. I kind of felt that they -- did you get involved with the community outside of the music?

Yes, I helped a lot of people outside of the band, outside of the music of the band, did a lot of (inaudible) and a lot of things for them out there, because the -- well, I got a lot of pleasure out of it.
Right. Right. You know what they say. Every time you give, you get it right back. And that's what it's really all about.
